text: A complaint dated 13.05.2026 was forwarded by the Railway Protection Force to Barauni Police Station, Begusarai, disclosing commission of a cognizable offence. It is alleged that Naseer Ahmed and Om Prakash Bhardwaj, holding themselves out as representatives of Sunrise Minerals, collected Rs.8,28,347 from 14 persons of Barauni, Begusarai against promised overseas employment. The offer letters and visa documents supplied were found to be fabricated. The premises were vacated and mobile number 8690709160 switched off. Simranjit Bains is stated to have received the collections in cash. Accordingly a case under section 420 (BNS 318(4)) has been registered vide FIR No. 150/2026 at Barauni Police Station and investigation has been taken up.
